title: 2018 HMMT November Guts Problem 9
statement: Farmer James has some strange animals. His hens have 2 heads and 8 legs, his peacocks have 3 heads and 9 legs, and his zombie hens have 6 heads and 12 legs. Farmer James counts 800 heads and 2018 legs on his farm. What is the number of animals that Farmer James has on his farm?

solutions.text:
Answer: 203
Note that each animal has 6 more legs than heads. Thus, if there are \(n\) animals, then there are \(6 n\) more legs than heads in total. There are \(2018-800=1218\) more legs than heads in total, so there are \(\frac{1218}{6}=203\) animals.
